subject: English
question_text: Read the following text and fill in each gap with a
stimulus: suitable word based on the information of the text.15 = 5 Citizen having good character live a life of virtue. They may belong to any social class. But their thoughts and behaviour show high moral values. That is, they have a strong sense of right and wrong. So, what they do is good for themselves as well as for others in the family and in the society. In fact they cannot even think of doing any wrong to others. One of the most positive qualities of these people is tolerance to others. Suppose, a group of people in your community believe or practise in something which you do not like personally. But as a good citizen you should allow them to perform activities. Thus tolerance can generate respect for people of other culture. Tolerance and respect together can make life harmonious and peaceful in society. [Unit-1; Lesson-3] Almost all kinds of moral values are (a) ⎯ by a good citizen. (b) ⎯ a strong sense of right and wrong, he can never think doing anything bad for the society. He always prefer showing respect to others (c) ⎯ . He turns a (d) ⎯ ear to the evil talks. His aim is to (e) ⎯ peace and harmony in the society. Read the passage and answer the questions 4 and 5. Sir Jagadish Chandra Bose was born in Bikrampur, Dhaka, on November 30, 1858. He passed the Entrance Examination in 1875 from Hare School and got himself admitted into St. Xavier's College, Calcutta. He received a Bachelor degree from the University of Calcutta in 1879. He did his B.Sc. Degree from the University of London in 1884. He returned India in 1885 and joined Presidency College as an Assistant Professor of Physics. Bose wrote a book called 'Response in the living and Non-living' in 1902 and in that book he proved that plants are sensitive to heat, cold, light, noise and other external stimuli just like human beings. The discovery made him world famous. He passed away on November 23, 1937.
